experiment: E4i best_bf16 search, stage 2 (SmolVLA): per-part GEMM autotuning, bf16_islands
precision: per rung: raw/rows/<rung>_N<N>.json rung_desc.precision_flags and param_dtype_bytes
rung: per row: bf16_mpad_graphs_ae_at, bf16_mpad_graphs_ae_at_islands, bf16_mpad_graphs_islands, bf16_mpad_graphs_nofuse_islands
variant: n/a: ladder rungs as defined in bench/rungs.py
num_denoise_steps: 10 (extra N per rung for the slope: by_N in the row files)
n_warmup: >= 20 and until no new graph for 5 inferences (warmup_iters per row)
